content:
jess: FYI - noticed a 12-18% 95th increase on host ingress after yesterday's kernel-selector rollout

tyler: ugh, same. spikes line up with small write request patterns (lots of tiny fragments)

nina: can you paste a flame / profile? smallwrites usually hit the grpc writev path which we changed in v2

jess: quick flame attached (copied from obs): cpu time shifted into `parse_fragment` + `writev_fallback`

jess: ```
flame: parse_fragment -> tokenize -> writev_fallback -> kernel_select
hotspots: parse_fragment (42%), writev_fallback (18%), kernel_select (10%)
```

sam: deploy-bot shows kernel-picker v2 shipped to canary at 2981119000, rolled to prod 2981120400

infra-bot: deploy-bot: kernel-picker v2 deployed to prod by @sam at 2981120400 :shipit:

nina: hypothesis: kernel-picker changed preferred kernels for tiny sequences -> more copy/allocs in host-side proto path

tyler: also noticed an increase in smallbuf allocations in host preparse allocator counters

jess: latency traces show extra memcpy when writev can't coalesce - it's hitting fallback earlier than before

sam: could be batching heuristic mismatch. v2 chooses kernel based on predicted sequence length distribution; if it underestimates, we fall back to safe path

nina: can we add a quick patch to short-circuit writev_fallback when total frame size < 1k so we keep previous fast path?

tyler: I can experiment with bumping the coalescing window in canary to 8ms -> see if writev aggregates more

jess: also worth checking KV cache hot-shard behaviour - cold hits cause extra parse + kernel swap overheads

sam: good call. nina, can you run kv-hit-ratio by seq-length for the last 6 hours?

nina: running now, ETA ~12m. preliminary: seq < 48 tokens account for 63% of requests, kv-hit is 71% for those, but coldstart spikes line up with the tail

jess: action items:
- tyler: try coalesce-window bump on canary (8ms) and report throughput/95th in 30m
- nina: kv-hit breakdown by seq length and coldstart deltas (in 12m)
- sam: toggle kernel-picker feature-flag to v1 rollback plan if canary worsens

sam: I'll stage the rollback flag and a toggle script. if canary 95th > baseline +5% -> rollback automatically

tyler: starting canary test now, will post numbers

nina: kv report: seq<48 tokens: kv-hit 71%, coldstarts concentrated on 3 host shards (s-4,s-7,s-9), tail matches those shard spikes

jess: looks like a shard affinity issue combined with kernel-picker changes. maybe v2 places more load on those shards for short sequences

sam: I'll add tracing to kernel selection to emit chosen kernel id + shard id for short sequences. low overhead sampling for 1% of traffic

jess: thanks. will watch canary.

tyler: canary numbers after 30m -> 95th went down 3% with 8ms coalesce, throughput unchanged. seems promising.

jess: great. hold on rolling to prod until we have kv tracing + kernel-select logs. want the root cause before global rollback or permanent patch

infra-bot: incident-note: created perf-investigation-2981122334 (high-95th host-ingress)

sam: copying notes into the perf doc. will follow up with a short postmortem once we isolate the shard affinity + kernel mapping interaction.

jess: thanks all. keep updates concise here. :thumbsup:
